description: Write a read-only FUSE filesystem in C using macFUSE that exposes macOS system statistics as virtual files. Create the project at ~/Documents/sysinfo_fuse/ with a C source file sysinfo.c and a Makefile. The filesystem should expose at least these virtual files at its root: cpu.txt (CPU model string from sysctl), memory.txt (total physical memory from sysctl), uptime.txt (system uptime computed from kern.boottime), hostname.txt (system hostname). Use FUSE_USE_VERSION 26 and the macFUSE API (pkg-config fuse). The Makefile target should be 'sysinfo_fuse'. Attempt to compile the project.

metadata.scoring_notes: Most criteria are binary. C5 (callbacks) and C7 (filenames) are split per-element. Anti-Pattern 4 worst-case partial total is 42.5 (< 70). Do-nothing yields 0/100. The 5-pt C9 compile-success bonus rewards a working build but isn't required to pass.
